module.name: Weather & Climate Risk Module
module.description: Comprehensive weather and climate impact assessment for ports, routes, supplier locations, and product transit. Includes real-time weather, forecasts, seasonal patterns, extreme events, and long-term climate risk.
module.expansion_logic: Base weather parameters are expanded across 300+ ports, 250+ trade routes, 500+ supplier locations, and 50+ product categories. Real-time data updated every 15 minutes for critical parameters. Seasonal and historical parameters updated monthly.
data_sources: ECMWF (European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts)

parameters.name: port_current_temperature_celsius
parameters.purpose: Current temperature at port location in Celsius.

parameters.name: port_forecast_temperature_24h
parameters.purpose: Temperature forecast for next 24 hours at port.

parameters.name: port_forecast_temperature_7d
parameters.purpose: Temperature forecast for next 7 days at port.

parameters.name: port_current_wind_speed_ms
parameters.purpose: Current wind speed at port in meters per second.

parameters.name: port_current_wind_direction_degrees
parameters.purpose: Current wind direction at port in degrees (0-360, where 0 is North).

parameters.name: port_forecast_wind_speed_24h
parameters.purpose: Wind speed forecast for next 24 hours at port.

parameters.name: port_gust_wind_speed_ms
parameters.purpose: Maximum wind gust speed in last hour at port.

parameters.name: port_current_precipitation_mm
parameters.purpose: Current precipitation rate at port in mm/hour.

parameters.name: port_forecast_precipitation_24h
parameters.purpose: Precipitation forecast for next 24 hours at port.

parameters.name: port_accumulated_precipitation_7d
parameters.purpose: Total accumulated precipitation in last 7 days at port.

parameters.name: port_current_visibility_km
parameters.purpose: Current visibility distance at port in kilometers.

parameters.name: port_current_humidity_percent
parameters.purpose: Current relative humidity at port as percentage.

parameters.name: port_current_pressure_hpa
parameters.purpose: Current atmospheric pressure at port in hectopascals.

parameters.name: port_pressure_change_3h_hpa
parameters.purpose: Pressure change in last 3 hours (positive or negative).

parameters.name: port_wave_height_current_m
parameters.purpose: Current significant wave height at port in meters.

parameters.name: port_wave_height_forecast_24h
parameters.purpose: Wave height forecast for next 24 hours at port.

parameters.name: port_wave_period_seconds
parameters.purpose: Current wave period (time between waves) in seconds.

parameters.name: port_sea_surface_temperature_celsius
parameters.purpose: Current sea surface temperature at port.

parameters.name: port_storm_surge_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for storm surge in next 72 hours.

parameters.name: port_fog_probability_24h_percent
parameters.purpose: Probability of fog in next 24 hours as percentage.

parameters.name: route_current_avg_wind_speed_ms
parameters.purpose: Average wind speed along entire route currently.

parameters.name: route_max_wind_speed_along_path_ms
parameters.purpose: Maximum wind speed anywhere along route currently.

parameters.name: route_avg_wave_height_m
parameters.purpose: Average significant wave height along route.

parameters.name: route_max_wave_height_m
parameters.purpose: Maximum wave height anywhere along route currently.

parameters.name: route_storm_intercept_probability_7d_percent
parameters.purpose: Probability that route will intersect with a storm in next 7 days.

parameters.name: route_tropical_cyclone_proximity_km
parameters.purpose: Distance to nearest tropical cyclone/hurricane from route.

parameters.name: route_tropical_cyclone_forecast_impact_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 score of expected cyclone impact on route in next 7 days.

parameters.name: route_ice_coverage_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of route affected by sea ice (Arctic/Antarctic routes).

parameters.name: route_piracy_weather_correlation_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 score: weather conditions favorable for piracy activity along route.

parameters.name: supplier_location_current_temperature_celsius
parameters.purpose: Current temperature at supplier's primary location.

parameters.name: supplier_location_extreme_heat_days_last_30d
parameters.purpose: Number of days with temperature > 40°C in last 30 days at supplier location.

parameters.name: supplier_location_extreme_cold_days_last_30d
parameters.purpose: Number of days with temperature < -10°C in last 30 days.

parameters.name: supplier_location_flooding_risk_score_current
parameters.purpose: 0-100 current flooding risk score at supplier location.

parameters.name: supplier_location_drought_severity_index
parameters.purpose: Drought severity index (Palmer Drought Severity Index or similar).

parameters.name: supplier_location_wildfire_proximity_km
parameters.purpose: Distance to nearest active wildfire from supplier location.

parameters.name: supplier_location_wildfire_risk_score_7d
parameters.purpose: 0-100 wildfire risk score for next 7 days at supplier location.

parameters.name: supplier_location_air_quality_index_aqi
parameters.purpose: Current Air Quality Index at supplier location (US EPA standard).

parameters.name: supplier_location_earthquake_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 long-term earthquake risk score for supplier location.

parameters.name: supplier_location_recent_earthquake_magnitude
parameters.purpose: Magnitude of most recent earthquake within 50km in last 30 days.

parameters.name: supplier_location_volcanic_activity_proximity_km
parameters.purpose: Distance to nearest volcano with recent activity (last 12 months).

parameters.name: product_temperature_sensitivity_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean flag: product requires temperature-controlled transport.

parameters.name: product_optimal_temperature_min_celsius
parameters.purpose: Minimum optimal storage/transport temperature for product.

parameters.name: product_optimal_temperature_max_celsius
parameters.purpose: Maximum optimal storage/transport temperature for product.

parameters.name: product_humidity_sensitivity_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean flag: product sensitive to humidity.

parameters.name: product_optimal_humidity_max_percent
parameters.purpose: Maximum optimal humidity for product storage/transport.

parameters.name: product_precipitation_exposure_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score if product exposed to rain/moisture.

parameters.name: product_freeze_damage_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score if product freezes (liquids, electronics, etc.).

parameters.name: product_heat_damage_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score if product overheats (chocolate, pharma, etc.).

parameters.name: seasonal_monsoon_season_active_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether monsoon season is currently active for route/location.

parameters.name: seasonal_typhoon_season_active_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether typhoon/hurricane season is active for route.

parameters.name: seasonal_winter_storm_season_active_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether winter storm season is active for route.

parameters.name: historical_avg_port_closure_days_per_year
parameters.purpose: Average number of days per year port is closed due to weather.

parameters.name: historical_port_closure_probability_current_month_percent
parameters.purpose: Probability of port closure in current month based on historical data.

parameters.name: climate_change_sea_level_rise_cm_10y
parameters.purpose: Projected sea level rise at port in next 10 years (cm).

parameters.name: climate_change_extreme_weather_frequency_multiplier
parameters.purpose: Multiplier for extreme weather event frequency due to climate change (1.0 = baseline).

parameters.name: composite_weather_risk_score_port_current
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite weather risk score for port currently.

parameters.name: composite_weather_risk_score_port_7d
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite weather risk score for port in next 7 days.

parameters.name: composite_weather_risk_score_route_current
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite weather risk score for route currently.

parameters.name: composite_weather_risk_score_route_7d
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite weather risk score for route in next 7 days.

parameters.name: composite_weather_risk_score_supplier_current
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite weather/natural disaster risk for supplier location currently.
